translations.web: Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
translations.bsb: But better than both is he who has not yet existed, who has not seen the evil that is done under the sun.
translations.kjv: Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
translations.asv: yea, better than them both did I esteem him that hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
